name: Where Control Ends
source:
A psychological horror visual novel about memory, guilt, and the fear of what lies within.

Astra is used to keeping herself under control. A tidy home, carefully chosen words, ordinary plans for the day. But beneath that calm lie gaps in her memory, traces of blood, and questions she is afraid to answer.

The return of a childhood friend and an unexpected encounter disturb the fragile balance of her solitary life. Warmth, curiosity, and the desire for connection begin to return. At the same time, her past grows harder to ignore.

And the voice inside speaks as though it has always known what she wants.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4711360/Where_Control_Ends/?curator_clanid=41316928]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部探讨记忆、负罪感以及对内心潜藏之物深感恐惧的心理恐怖视觉小说。

阿斯特拉习惯于将自己的一切掌控得井井有条：整洁的住所、字斟句酌的言谈、按部就班的日常计划。然而在这份平静之下，却埋藏着记忆的断层、斑驳的血迹，以及她不敢回答的种种疑问。

一位青梅竹马的归来与一场不期而遇的邂逅，打破了她独居生活脆弱的平衡。温暖、好奇心以及与他人建立联结的渴望开始复苏；与此同时，她的过去也变得愈发难以忽视。

而她心底的那个声音开口低语，仿佛从一开始便深知她真正渴望的是什么。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4711360/Where_Control_Ends/?curator_clanid=41316928]Steam[/url]]
